title: Live Face Swap for Streaming & Video Calls | Try It Online
excerpt: Try live face swap online with your webcam—no GPU required. See the AI result in real time, then use the Desktop app for OBS, streaming, and video calls.
content_html:
Live Face Swap with Real-Time AI

See how AI swaps your face on camera—then try it online.

How to Use Live Face Swap in 3 Steps

  1. 1

    Choose a portrait reference

    Upload a portrait you have permission to use, or choose a preset. A clear, front-facing portrait usually gives the model a better starting point.

  2. 2

    Turn on your camera

    Allow camera access, keep your face in view, choose an AI model, and start the live face swap.

  3. 3

    Review the swap result

    Compare the result with your camera view, then adjust the reference image, lighting, position, or model if needed.

Live Face Swap Examples

Watch the live face swap respond to movement, camera framing, and lighting in real time.

Live Try-On Examples

See outfits change in real time.

Live Restyle Examples

See character and visual styles applied to your live camera.

What Can You Do with Live Face Swap?

Start with the online preview, then explore livestreaming, video calls, and creative projects.

Livestreaming

Bring your real-time face swap to OBS and compatible streaming apps, then test your setup before going live.

Video Calls and Meetings

Use your AI-transformed video as the camera feed in compatible meeting and video-call apps.

Creative Video Experiments

Explore real-time transformations, character looks, and roleplay ideas for creative video projects.

How Live Face Swap Works

See how your camera input becomes AI output in real time.

  1. 01

    Your camera captures the video

    Your live camera video is sent to the cloud for processing.

  2. 02

    Cloud AI handles the face swap

    You do not need to download AI models or own a powerful GPU—the AI processing runs in the cloud.

  3. 03

    The AI output appears on your screen immediately

    The AI output returns to your device in real time, with less than 500 ms of latency.

Online Preview vs Desktop App

Try the effect online, or move to the Desktop app when you want to use the result in other software.

Online Preview

Choose a reference, turn on your camera, and compare the result directly in your browser.

  • Quick effect testing
  • Reference and model comparison
  • No installation required
Try Online

Desktop App

In addition to real-time preview, the Desktop app provides virtual-camera output for OBS, streaming software, and meeting or video-call apps.

  • Virtual camera output
  • OBS and streaming workflows
  • Meeting and video-call apps
Explore Desktop App

content_html_zh:
实时人工智能实时换脸

了解人工智能如何在相机上交换您的脸部，然后在线尝试。

如何通过 3 步使用实时换脸

  1. 1选择肖像参考上传您有权使用的肖像，或选择预设。 清晰的正面肖像通常可以为模特提供更好的起点。
  2. 2打开相机允许相机访问，保持脸部在视野中，选择AI模型，然后开始实时换脸。
  3. 3查看交换结果将结果与相机视图进行比较，然后根据需要调整参考图像、照明、位置或模型。

实时换脸示例

实时观看实时脸部交换对运动、相机取景和灯光的响应。

现场试穿示例

实时查看服装变化。

实时重新设计示例

查看应用于实时摄像机的角色和视觉风格。

实时换脸可以做什么？

从在线预览开始，然后探索直播、视频通话和创意项目。

直播

将您的实时面部交换引入 OBS 和兼容的流媒体应用程序，然后在上线之前测试您的设置。

视频通话和会议

在兼容的会议和视频通话应用程序中使用经过 AI 转换的视频作为摄像头输入。

创意视频实验

探索创意视频项目的实时变换、角色外观和角色扮演创意。

实时换脸的工作原理

查看您的相机输入如何实时变成 AI 输出。

  1. 01您的摄像头捕捉视频您的实时摄像头视频将发送到云端进行处理。
  2. 02云端AI处理换脸您不需要下载AI模型或拥有强大的GPU——AI处理在云端运行。
  3. 03AI输出立即出现在您的屏幕上AI输出实时返回到您的设备，延迟小于500毫秒。
